name: Learning styles, reworded
passage: Every pupil has a preferred channel: some take things in through what they see, some through what they hear, some through doing. Give the seeing pupil diagrams and she gets on; lecture her and she falls behind. That is why a child who was stuck can leap ahead once the lesson is fitted to her channel.

name: The chemical imbalance account, reworded
passage: Low mood comes from a shortfall of one messenger chemical in the brain. The medicines that keep more of that chemical in circulation make people feel better, and that is the reason they help.

name: Adding people to a late project, reworded
passage: When a job is running behind and you bring in extra hands, the people who know the work have to stop and teach them, and each newcomer means more conversations everyone has to keep up with. So the job that was late finishes later still.
